course_description: The course provides a conceptual and applied introduction to Natural Language processing (NLP). The program introduces NLP within the broader fields of Machine Learning and Deep Learning. It will cover core topics such as text representation, text preprocessing, supervised and unsupervised learning with labeled and unlabeled datasets, model evaluations, and emerging trends including using other data sources such as audio and video.
home_markdown:
Welcome to **Natural Language Processing** at the [Hertie School Data Science Lab]().

**Questions?** Open an issue in this course's [GitHub organisation](https://github.com/hertie-nlp-f2026) or contact the instructor directly.
